initial_conditions: Two-piece Harbor, revision 23 with eight seams. Both material panels measure 640 mm in height.
actions: Step and export the original shirt. Lower both front hem vertices 50 mm. Save, close, reopen and step the changed shirt, then edit its left hem vertex again.
Run original and edited constructions through 60 native assembly steps and 120 gravity drape steps. Export both phase endpoints.
expected_outcomes: The regenerated front is 690 mm high. The back, seams and other authored fields survive exactly. Edited UVs reach the simulated surfaces. Evaluate both garments against the established 15% strain, 5 mm seam and 2 mm avatar/ground vertex limits.
scope: Independent WeftForge native behavior. Physics grades cover the four saved endpoints.
